items.title: Trump administration approved more than 879,000 AI chip sales to Chinese companies, per new disclosure.
items.excerpt: House Foreign Affairs Chair Brian Mast released Commerce Department license data showing more than 879,000 advanced AI chips approved for sale to Chinese companies (of ~3.4M requested), ahead of Jensen Huang's testimony; Ranking Member Meeks says licenses were approved with little scrutiny.

items.title: Jacobs, Maloy, Beyer Release Outline For Sweeping, Bipartisan AI Safety Legislation | U.S. Congresswoman Sara Jacobs Of California's 51st District
items.source: Office of Rep. Sara Jacobs (U.S. House)
items.excerpt: Reps. Jacobs (D-CA), Maloy (R-UT) and Beyer (D-VA) released an outline of the bipartisan SAFE AI Act, forthcoming legislation that would mandate safety frameworks, incident reporting and transparency from frontier AI labs under federal oversight. [off-list primary doc; page shows date only]

items.title: Governor Newsom’s nation-leading AI safety framework is getting even stronger as California releases next steps on mandatory safety standards and oversight | Governor of California
items.source: Office of the Governor of California
items.excerpt: California released expert recommendations for mandatory frontier-AI safety standards, independent oversight, emergency shutdown ('kill switch') authority for dangerous systems and limits on self-improving AI, as next steps on top of SB 53. [off-list primary doc]

items.title: Bipartisan bill would create cyber and AI review board amid series of tech outages
items.excerpt: A bipartisan House bill would create a federal cyber and AI review board to investigate major failures after a string of tech outages, and proposes safeguards for federal AI agents and closer CISA coordination with tech providers. [off-list]

items.title: New York attorney general creates unit to oversee AI safety and enforcement
items.excerpt: New York AG Letitia James created a dedicated AI Safety, Standards, Enforcement and Transparency (ASSET) unit to enforce state AI laws, including the RAISE Act taking effect January 1. [off-list]

items.title: Don't buy smart glasses, Dutch data watchdog advises
items.excerpt: The Dutch data protection authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) advised consumers not to buy AI smart glasses, citing tests where devices misread medicine instructions or pretended to call an ambulance, plus privacy risks to bystanders.

items.title: European Commission scrambles to contain AI-assisted cyberattack
items.excerpt: The European Commission confirmed an AI-assisted cyberattack in October that took staff HR and medical-reimbursement systems offline; officials are investigating whether personal data was compromised.

items.title: TSMC tightens China AI chip curbs as new US rules close manufacturing loophole, sources say - Taipei Times
items.excerpt: TSMC is tightening restrictions on Chinese chip designers, suspending some previously permitted advanced manufacturing orders and limiting them to older nodes, as new US rules close a manufacturing loophole (Reuters, sources).

items.title: Traumatized teens sue school, cops after Doritos bag triggers AI gun alert
items.excerpt: Four Baltimore County students sued their school system and police after an AI gun-detection system flagged a Doritos bag as a weapon; the suit alleges over 99% of the system's alerts were false positives.

items.title: Trump’s latest land grab is an AI hub in the Philippines
items.excerpt: Analysis of Trump's Philippines visit: the administration is eyeing the former US colony for chip fabs and AI data centers under the US-led Pax Silica chip/critical-minerals initiative, amid local 'Reject Pax Silica' protests.

items.title: Dutch resist ‘unacceptable’ US bid to tighten semiconductor export controls
items.excerpt: The Dutch government objected to the bipartisan US MATCH Act, which would tighten restrictions on ASML chipmaking-tool sales to China, calling the extraterritorial push 'unacceptable'.

items.title: Policies on the Use of Generative Super Intelligence in Agency Adjudication; Request for Comments
items.excerpt: The Administrative Conference of the United States requests public comment (due Jan 19, 2027) on policies for generative AI ('generative super intelligence') use by agency adjudicators, staff, parties and representatives in federal adjudications.

items.title: 윤재옥, 'AI커닝 퇴출법' 발의…"전자기기 반입시 최대 징역2년"
items.excerpt: 국민의힘 윤재옥 의원이 초소형 카메라·스마트안경 등 첨단기기를 이용한 시험 부정행위를 처벌하는 'AI커닝 퇴출법' 패키지를 발의했다. 전자기기 반입 시 최대 징역 2년 등을 담았다.

items.title: 與 '올 수능부터 AI 부정행위시 응시정지 10년' 법안 발의
items.excerpt: 더불어민주당이 수능 하루 전인 18일 AI 등을 활용한 부정행위자의 응시자격을 최대 10년 정지하고 올해 수능부터 적용하는 법안을 발의했다.

items.title: 수능 부정행위 98명 적발…AI 스마트안경·초소형 카메라 사용
items.excerpt: 교육부는 2027학년도 수능에서 총 98명의 부정행위자를 적발했다고 발표했다. 위급재난문자로 49명, 시험 중 AI 스마트안경·초소형 카메라 등 스마트기기 활용이 5건이다.

items.title: 개보위, 일본과 데이터 이전·AI프라이버시 협력 강화
items.excerpt: 개인정보위가 18일 브뤼셀에서 일본 개인정보보호위원회(PPC)와 회의를 열고 국외 데이터 이전과 AI 프라이버시 분야 협력을 강화하기로 했다.

items.title: 李대통령 “추진 중인 아태 AI센터…인공지능 협력·혁신 구심점될 것”
items.excerpt: 이재명 대통령이 APEC 선전 정상회의에서 추진 중인 '아태 AI센터'를 AI 협력·혁신의 구심점으로 삼겠다며 AI를 통한 공동 성장을 강조했다.

items.title: Australian music industry rejects ‘divide and conquer’ proposal to give musicians exemption from AI scraping
items.excerpt: Australia's music industry (ARIA) rejected a reported government proposal to exempt musicians from AI training on copyrighted works while letting big tech train on other creative material, calling the carve-out 'unworkable'.

items.title: LeBron James sues sports betting app Bron for using nickname and likeness without permission
items.excerpt: LeBron James sued sports-betting research app Bron, alleging it used an AI-generated version of his likeness, voice and nickname in ads to fake an endorsement.

items.title: Chinese tech firms face a double hit as chip shipments stop and overseas cloud access disappears
items.excerpt: Stricter US AI-chip export controls are biting: Moonshot AI walked away from an Indonesian deal and TSMC/Samsung stopped some shipments to Chinese customers as overseas cloud access closes.

items.title: Alberta sets limits on where AI data centres can be built amid backlash
items.excerpt: Alberta tabled Bill 42 setting limits on where large AI data centres can be built, including setbacks from homes and bars on irrigated farmland. [off-list]

items.title: Quad Leaders’ Summit Joint Press Release
items.excerpt: Quad leaders' joint release affirms the Quad 'Super Intelligence' (AI) Accelerator to coordinate and fund trusted AI access, deployment and technical assistance across the Indo-Pacific.

items.title: S’pore can facilitate US checks on AI chip use, won’t allow circumvention of export controls: PM Wong
items.excerpt: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong said Singapore can facilitate US checks on AI chip use and will not allow circumvention of export controls as it studies the new US rules. [off-list]

items.title: South African regulator settles with X Corp and x.AI
items.excerpt: South Africa's Competition Commission settled with X Corp and took a voluntary undertaking from X.AI to support local news publishers under its digital platforms inquiry remedies. [off-list]
